definitions: One side of a sheet of paper in a book, magazine, newspaper, or other collection of sheets.
A young boy or girl who attends to a person of rank, or who acts as a servant in a hotel or club.
A person employed to run errands, carry messages, or perform other minor tasks, especially in a legislative body or court.
A section of a website or application accessible via a specific URL or link.
examples: The hotel page carried the luggage.
A new web page was launched.
The page boy held the train of her dress.
